template.name: template_spritesheetbutton

spriteSheetComponent.name: BoundsSprite
spriteSheetComponent.event: local tvars = element:templateVars() component("hFlip"):SetInt(tvars.spriteHFlip) component("vFlip"):SetInt(tvars.spriteVFlip) component("spriteName"):Set(tvars.upSpriteName) component("sheetName"):Set(tvars.sheetName) component("size"):SetFloat(tvars.spriteScale) component("layer"):SetString(tvars.layer) component("alpha"):SetFloat(tvars.alpha) component("visible"):SetInt(0)

spriteSheetComponent.name: DownSprite
spriteSheetComponent.event: local tvars = element:templateVars() component("hFlip"):SetInt(tvars.spriteHFlip) component("vFlip"):SetInt(tvars.spriteVFlip) component("spriteName"):Set(tvars.downSpriteName) component("sheetName"):Set(tvars.sheetName) component("size"):SetFloat(tvars.spriteScale) component("visible"):SetInt(0) component("layer"):SetString(tvars.layer) component("alpha"):SetFloat(tvars.alpha)

textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event: local tvars = element:templateVars() component:GetVar("multiline"):SetInt(tvars.multiLine) component:GetVar("textPadding"):SetInt(tvars.textPadding) component:GetVar("font"):Set($font) component:GetVar("size"):SetFloat(tvars.spriteScale) component:GetVar("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_HCENTER_ALIGNED) component:GetVar("text"):SetString(tvars.text) component:GetVar("xOffset"):SetInt(tvars.textXOffset) component:GetVar("yOffset"):SetInt(tvars.textYOffset) component:GetVar("autoScaleFactor"):SetFloat(tvars.autoScaleFactor) component:GetVar("autoScale"):SetInt(1) component:GetVar("layer"):SetString(tvars.layer) component:GetVar("alpha"):SetFloat(tvars.alpha) component:setColor(tvars.textTintR, tvars.textTintG, tvars.textTintB)

touchComponent.name: Touch
touchComponent.event:
local tvars = element:templateVars() if tvars.downSpriteName ~= "''" then element["UpSprite"]("visible"):SetInt(0) element["DownSprite"]("visible"):SetInt(1) else element["UpSprite"]:setColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) end element["Text"]:setColor(tvars.textTintR/2, tvars.textTintG/2, tvars.textTintB/2)
element("ButtonState"):SetInt(game.BUTTON_PRESSED) element("TickTimer"):SetFloat(0.0)

local tvars = element:templateVars() if tvars.downSpriteName ~= "''" then element["UpSprite"]("visible"):SetInt(1) element["DownSprite"]("visible"):SetInt(0) else element["UpSprite"]:setColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) end element["Text"]:setColor(tvars.textTintR, tvars.textTintG, tvars.textTintB)
element("ButtonState"):SetInt(game.BUTTON_RELEASED) element("TickTimer"):SetFloat(0.0)

template.event:
local tvars = element:templateVars()
-- might have already been set in setVisible or setInvisible if element.isVisible == nil then element.isVisible = true end
element:setPositionBroadcast(true) element("locked"):SetInt(0) -- Used so I can disable after a touch
if tonumber(tvars.buttonMapping) ~= 0 or tonumber(tvars.buttonMappingAlt) ~= 0 then element("buttonDown"):SetInt(0) element:SetupGenericListener(game.engineReceiver(), "sys::msg::MsgKeyDown", "gotMsgKeyDown") element:SetupGenericListener(game.engineReceiver(), "sys::msg::MsgKeyUp", "gotMsgKeyUp") end
element("ButtonState"):SetInt(game.BUTTON_IDLE) element("TickTimer"):SetFloat(0.0) element("isCurrentlyLocked"):SetInt(0) element("alpha"):SetFloat(tvars.alpha)
element("prevTouchState"):SetInt(0)
element.spriteScale = tvars.spriteScale
template.function:
element.isVisible = true element["UpSprite"]("visible"):SetInt(1) element["Text"]("visible"):SetInt(1)
-- If someone made this invisible then we can't force it to be touchable if element["UpSprite"]("alpha"):GetFloat() == 0 then element["Touch"]("enabled"):SetInt(0) element("prevTouchState"):SetInt(0) else element["Touch"]("enabled"):SetInt(1) element("prevTouchState"):SetInt(1); end
-- Force update the text because it wont respect the padding otherwise element["Text"]:V("text"):SetString('') element["Text"]:onInit(element) -- unfortunately this adds a hard-to find "gotcha" that breaks anyone who ever sets any text property changes in a postInit -- (i.e. onInit is not expected to be called!)

element.isVisible = false element["UpSprite"]("visible"):SetInt(0) element["DownSprite"]("visible"):SetInt(0) element["Text"]("visible"):SetInt(0) element["Touch"]("enabled"):SetInt(0) element("prevTouchState"):SetInt(0);

local tvars = element:templateVars() if tvars.downSpriteName ~= "''" then if(element.isVisible) then element["UpSprite"]("visible"):SetInt(1) element["DownSprite"]("visible"):SetInt(0) end else element["UpSprite"]:setColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) end element["Text"]:setColor(tvars.textTintR, tvars.textTintG, tvars.textTintB)
-- If someone made this invisible then we can't force it to be touchable if element["UpSprite"]("alpha"):GetFloat() == 0 then element["Touch"]("enabled"):SetInt(0) element("prevTouchState"):SetInt(0); else element["Touch"]("enabled"):SetInt(1) element("prevTouchState"):SetInt(1); end

local tvars = element:templateVars() if tvars.downSpriteName ~= "''" then if(element.isVisible) then element["UpSprite"]("visible"):SetInt(0) element["DownSprite"]("visible"):SetInt(1) end else element["UpSprite"]:setColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) end element["Text"]:setColor(tvars.textTintR/2, tvars.textTintG/2, tvars.textTintB/2) element["Touch"]("enabled"):SetInt(0) element("prevTouchState"):SetInt(0);
template.event: if msg.key.val == 0 then return end local tvars = element:templateVars() if (tonumber(tvars.buttonMapping) == msg.key.val or tonumber(tvars.buttonMappingAlt) == msg.key.val) and element["Touch"]("enabled"):GetInt() ~= 0 and element("buttonDown"):GetInt() == 0 then if(element["Touch"]:onTop()) then element("buttonDown"):SetInt(msg.key.val) element["Touch"]:DoStoredScript("onTouchDown") end end

if msg.key.val == 0 then return end local tvars = element:templateVars() if (tonumber(tvars.buttonMapping) == msg.key.val or tonumber(tvars.buttonMappingAlt) == msg.key.val) and element["Touch"]("enabled"):GetInt() ~= 0 and element("buttonDown"):GetInt() == msg.key.val then if(element["Touch"]:onTop()) then element("buttonDown"):SetInt(0) element["Touch"]:DoStoredScript("onTouchUp") end end

element["BoundsSprite"]:setClipRect(x, y, w, h) element["UpSprite"]:setClipRect(x, y, w, h) element["DownSprite"]:setClipRect(x, y, w, h) element["Text"]:setClipRect(x, y, w, h) element["Touch"]:setClipRect(x, y, w, h)
